sections.content: Defines the acceptance coordinator command set for slice checks, terminal evidence, regression suites, and the full terminal run. Commands are repository-scoped, non-shell invocations with bounded timeouts and no requested authorizations.
sections.title: Command registry

sections.content: Specifies the plan-ready acceptance coordinator contract. Four slices cover identity and authority, deterministic routing, idempotency and stale recovery, and the one-shot coordinator. Changes are limited to the named skill scripts, documentation, and tests; protected platform, runtime, logs, and knowledge paths are forbidden.
sections.title: Implementation contract

sections.content: Requires candidate and runner binding, bundle-owned context, machine-selected deterministic routing, immutable replay, successor recovery, reentrant coordinator execution, telemetry, and typed semantic handoff termination. Non-goals exclude background supervision, deterministic Bootstrap invocation, knowledge publication, lifecycle changes, and historical evidence rewrites.
